title: b7z9.25.3: Python+Rust: add wall_clock_valid gate to desync FSM recovery
description: Spec R-02a-084: MUST NOT leave DESYNCED unless wall_clock_valid=true. Python on_beacon(valid: bool) and Rust on_beacon(valid: bool) have no wall_clock input, though the wall_clock_valid flag exists in status messages. Add wall_clock_valid parameter to on_beacon() in both impls. DESYNCED->RECOVERING transition requires wall_clock_valid=true.
